Implementation: Create Init Notification API

Summary

Implemented the GET /notification/init endpoint to provide a single initial total count aggregating all unread notifications (views_total_unread_notifications) and user drafts (views_total_draft_posts_per_user).

Files Created & Updated

1. Action Handler & Helper

  • src/Action/V1/Notifications/InitNotification.go:
    • Implemented InitNotification(c *fiber.Ctx) error.
    • Added strict role validation (if role != "user") to reject viewer and unauthenticated callers with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
    • Added pure aggregation helper CalculateTotalNotification(notifications []Models.TotalUnreadNotification, totalDraft int64) int64.
    • Handled user authorization and encryption ec == "true".
    • Returned response envelope with single overall total field.

2. Controller & Route Registration

  • src/Controllers/V1/NotificationsControllers.go:
    • Added InitNotification(c *fiber.Ctx) error forwarding to NotificationsAction.InitNotification(c).
  • src/Routes/V1/NotificationsRoutes.go:
    • Registered notification.Get("/init", Controllers.InitNotification).

3. Unit Tests

  • src/Action/V1/Notifications/InitNotification_test.go:
    • Added TestInitNotificationRejectsInvalidRole and TestInitNotificationRejectsViewer for auth/role validation.
    • Added table-driven tests TestCalculateTotalNotification covering multiple combinations of notification categories and drafts.
  • src/Routes/V1/NotificationsRoutes_test.go:
    • Added route verification test ensuring GET /notification/init is properly registered in the Fiber app stack.

4. API Collection

  • api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Notification/Init Notification.yml:
    • Added Bruno API request specification with examples.

Verification

go test -v -count=1 ./src/Action/V1/Notifications/... ./src/Routes/V1/...
go vet ./src/...
go build ./...

All tests passed with zero failures and the binary builds without errors.

Problem

In the notification feature, users have several notification categories such as posts, drafts, and followings displayed in the navigation and notification bell badge. Previously, the client had to make separate calls or lacked an initial aggregate endpoint to fetch the overall count of unread notifications and drafts. An endpoint was needed to initialize notification counts by returning a single unified total combining unread notifications and drafts.

Scope

  • Create a new endpoint GET /notification/init registered under notification routes in src/Routes/V1/NotificationsRoutes.go.
  • Implement handler InitNotification in src/Action/V1/Notifications/InitNotification.go and expose via src/Controllers/V1/NotificationsControllers.go.
  • Query unread notifications from views_total_unread_notifications for the authenticated user_id.
  • Query total drafts from views_total_draft_posts_per_user for the authenticated user_id.
  • Sum unread notifications and draft posts into a single total response field.
  • Support standard encryption response when ec=true.
  • Add unit tests for route registration, unauthorized access handling, and calculation logic.
  • Add API collection request file in api-collection/Panorra API Feeds/Notification/Init Notification.yml.

Behavior Boundary

  • Endpoint is read-only.
  • Only authenticated users with valid credentials can access the endpoint (401 on unauthorized).
  • Returns unified total count:
{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "Init Notification",
    "total": 2
  }
}

Out of Scope

  • Modifying existing database views or tables (views_total_unread_notifications, views_total_draft_posts_per_user).
  • Modifying slim API implementations or adding sl handling.
  • Creating or pushing Git commits.

Acceptance Criteria

  • GET /notification/init is registered in src/Routes/V1/NotificationsRoutes.go.
  • Query correctly calculates the sum of all unread notifications from views_total_unread_notifications plus total drafts from views_total_draft_posts_per_user.
  • Unit tests pass with 0 failures (go test ./src/Action/V1/Notifications/... ./src/Routes/V1/...).
  • Project compiles cleanly (go build ./...).

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-09-22.
